authoringMethod: Original instructions, manually chosen illustrative numeric inputs, hand-determined baseline and changed-input expectations, deterministic model-engine verification, and source-based overlap review. No earlier SKILL text was copied.
scope: Public issuer equity, shares, accounting reconciliation and focused valuation components. No live market-data retrieval, complete valuation from a small fixture, trading, account writes or installed recurring schedule is claimed.

sourceAccess.method: Web tool opened primary standard-setter pages, regulator guidance, official investor education and academic/author educational sources. Standard summaries and accessible materials were reviewed; current full IFRS33 PDF redirected to subscription access, so no full-current-standard review is claimed.
sourceAccess.currentStandardAccessLimit: Detailed filing work requires the applicable current standard and jurisdiction. The publicly indexed IFRS rights example is an historical exposure-draft illustration, not proof of current accounting compliance.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Existing lease-accounting-calculator already calculates lease PV, liabilities, ROU and amortization; a renamed wrapper would not add a distinct method.
Existing deferred-tax-calculator explicitly proves statutory-to-effective rate reconciliation.
Existing deferred-tax-calculator already covers recoverability and valuation allowance; rejected in favor of current-tax cash reconciliation.

rejectedCandidates.candidate: Generic DCF, comps or stock report
rejectedCandidates.reason: Existing company-fair-value-modeler, peer-multiples-table-builder and stock research/report skills already perform these broad jobs.

meaningfulBoundaries: Public EPS rights/option/convertible methods are issuer filing accounting, distinct from private contractual ownership, option pools and round economics.
Operating-credit author owns invoice/cash operations and credit models; these public methods reconcile issuer disclosure perimeters and financial-statement cash flows.
Every model is a focused component with explicit units, rates as decimals and source evidence checks; the illustration does not prove a full investment conclusion.
All workflows require linked actual sourced native schedules; they do not chain numerical example outputs as though those were company facts.
Agents preserve source versions and prior accepted models, take a specific evidence branch and have manual/supplied-evidence triggers without claiming installed monitoring.

validation.scope: Author deterministic tests and schema checks only; native workbook arithmetic/reopen/render and independent semantic/visual review are separately owned and reported.

correctionsBeforeFinalFreeze.reason: Added positive remaining-share denominator guard and invalid all-share retirement case before initial 40-model freeze.
Added positive-NAV discount denominator guard and explicit nonpositive-NAV refusal before initial freeze.
Added positive comparable prior-revenue denominator guard and invalid perimeter case before initial freeze.

Independent peer found a positive supplied value could imply negative reinvestment and a meaningless negative ROC. Root was notified before adding the positive-rate guard and value2000 invalid case; only this native model needs the notified rebuild.
Display name changed to Receivables allowance roll-forward as requested. Stable slug and model math unchanged.

limitations: Method accuracy, source completeness and jurisdiction applicability remain separate from mathematical fixture success.
Historical source labels and examples are not market recommendations or current forecasts. All numeric examples are illustrative and contain no real issuer or market values.

Some analytical schedules intentionally use restricted fixture domains or assumptions, such as constant capital, simple awards, zero other balance changes and specific currency conventions; full instructions require expanding actual schedules when source complexity differs.
No source truth, model-generated investment outcome, live account action or deployment was tested by the author.
